summary: E2E testing of the ZEV SHOP ASICS GEL-NYC integration (3 variants) + TN regressions. Catalogue grid, filters, product page, carousel animation, cart (desktop+mobile, persistence), wishlist (auth required), header search, home hero/categories, mobile buy panel, and TN regression — all working as specified. Backend login via UI OK. Price displays as 'Prix à définir' everywhere (null prices intentional); cart total uses 'PRIX BIENTÔT' (minor copy inconsistency, not a bug per spec).

ui_bugs.issue: On the wishlist tab (/compte, tab WISHLIST) the product cards are rendered inside a narrow column — product title and color label get clipped horizontally (only the first letter visible: 'A', 'C', 'N'). Index/price/image render fine. Likely CSS: grid uses too narrow min column or the card layout overflows. Repro: login test@zevshop.com, add asics-01 to wishlist, go to /compte > WISHLIST.

issues: Total label is 'PRIX BIENTÔT' while the rest of the UI uses 'Prix à définir'. Consider aligning copy for consistency (both are honest no-price placeholders).

action_items: Fix the wishlist tab card layout in Compte.js so the ProductCard renders with full width (currently clipping title/color label).
(Optional) Align CartDrawer total placeholder label with 'Prix à définir' for copy consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: Product.js useEffect([idx]) correctly plays Z-logo pulse on variant change (eslint missing-dep warning is pre-existing and intentional).
ColorSelectors already uses idPrefix for mobile — mobile testids correct (color-selector-mobile-asics-0X).
PRODUCTS flat list ordering guarantees ASICS first (indices 01-07) — matches spec.
CartDrawer logic for total is safe (no invented prices).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: catalogue 7 cards ASICS-first with dynamic 01-07 indices; filter-color-asics-02 narrows to 1 card; tab NOUVEAUTÉS/CHAUSSURES = 7 cards, VÊTEMENTS/ACCESSOIRES honest empty; /produit/asics-01 title 'ASICS GEL-NYC — COLORIS 1', 7 size chips, 3 color pastilles asics-01/02/03, 'Prix à définir' + EN STOCK (uses  ); clicking color-selector-asics-02 then -03 updates URL and title (carrousel animation OK visually); add-to-cart from desktop AND mobile (add-to-cart-button-mobile) increments cart-count badge; cart item line 'ASICS GEL-NYC — COLORIS 2' with 'Coloris : Coloris 2 — EU 42' and 'Prix à définir' per-item; cart persists after reload; wishlist blocked for guest (toast 'Créez un compte...'), after login via auth-submit-button adding on asics-01 persists and appears in /compte > account-tab-wishlist (BUT card rendering is clipped — see UI bug); header search returns 3 ASICS for 'asics' and 4 TN for 'TN'; home hero still TN noir, nouveautés section lists ASICS first, categories card still TN cyan; /produit/noir has 4 TN color selectors only (no ASICS); /categorie/chaussures = 7, /categorie/vetements empty. Mobile 390 has no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth==clientWidth==390).
rca of the issue: Wishlist card clipping: likely the Compte.js wishlist tab renders ProductCard inside a container that lacks a responsive grid (max-w-md or single-column too narrow). Suggest switching to the same grid as /catalogue (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3) or wrap ProductCard with w-full and remove any max-width constraint on its parent.
